P1.quote: So I can't scaffold the project yet. What I can do is settle the decisions that are hardest to change later.

P2.quote: **Membership types:** monthly unlimited only, or also limited plans (say 8 classes a month), class packs or drop-in passes?

P4.quote: Avoid a separately branded app per gym: Apple usually rejects near-identical template apps unless each gym submits its own, and it multiplies your release work.

P5.quote: The database itself should stop one gym from ever seeing another gym's data, rather than relying on the app code to remember.

P6.quote: Stripe notifies your backend when a payment succeeds or fails, and the app uses that to decide whether a member can book. An unpaid member can't book.
